## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector participation (8/11) alongside mixed leadership—SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND show strength while XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION highlights divergence.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear modestly easing: VXX (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND. Credit conditions neutral: HYG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.72% | 1M: -0.65%) RECOVERY.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral: SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%) RECOVERY — stock/bond stance roughly balanced and dollar shows no clear edge.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech and materials leading: XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing steady participation: XLF (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND. Defensives lag: XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND and XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION — Style: Growth/momentum leading.

5. US vs Global?
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND vs EEM (1W: +2.42% | 1M: -1.71%) RECOVERY and FXI (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +8.26%) CORRECTION—EM has pockets of strength but mixed.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative flows present: ARKK (1W: +11.50% | 1M: -2.58%) RECOVERY and IBIT (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND while IWM (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +1.45%) ABOVE TREND shows small-cap participation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals strong: GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%) ABOVE TREND; copper/industrial metals steady with CPER (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +5.70%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed and correcting: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION with USO (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%) CORRECTION, while natural gas UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Broad participation across sectors (8/11) and SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: QQQ (1W: +5.09% | 1M: -0.03%) RECOVERY and several commodity/outlook corrections (XLE, USO, BNO) merit close monitoring.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to growth/momentum pockets showing strength (XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND, XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to rate/energy-sensitive defensives (XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND, XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION); bonds neutral (TLT (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%) RECOVERY).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND, XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION, XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: SLV (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%) ABOVE TREND, GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND, USO (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%) CORRECTION.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (fear/complacency pivot), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit-health reference), XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength while XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION is the key divergence to monitor.
